variants.title: Temperature coefficient of resistance with a Pt1000 resistance thermometer
variants.sample: Pt1000 platinum element (1000 ohm at 0 degC)
variants.unknown: the temperature coefficient of resistance of platinum
variants.note: A Pt1000 has the same coefficients A and B as a Pt100 but ten times the resistance, so the leads matter less. The bridge arms are 1000 ohm.

source.title: IEC 60751: Pt1000 industrial platinum resistance thermometer, R0 = 1000 ohm, same A and B as Pt100

variants.aim: Measure the resistance of a Pt1000 element at the ice point and at the steam point and find its mean temperature coefficient of resistance between 0 and 100 °C.
